title: RNA-seq of human donors with severe type 1 interferonopathy due to germline STAT2 gain-of-function
description: Patients with type 1 interferonopathies due to mutations in one of 10 genes were recruited over the course of 4 years. All patients had raised levels of interferon stimulated genes as determined by qPCR. A transcriptome analysis was carried out to compare levels of interferon stimulated genes in the patient with a mutation in STAT2, compared to patients with mutations in other interferonopathy genes.

samples.title: Sample 13
samples.description: Protocols: Whole blood was collected into PAXgene tubes (Qiagen, Valencia, CA). Written informed consent for the use of patient material was provided. Ethical approval was granted by the NRES Committee Leeds (East) (Ref: 07/Q1206/7). Samples were collected and RNAseq undertaken. ISG score was calculated as described in PMID: 24183309. The genotypes leading to interferonopathy were assigned according to PMID: 30633609. Total RNA extracted using a PreAnalytix RNA isolation kit. RNA integrity was analysed on an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer. Truseq stranded mRNA Assay. Paired end.
